name: Swinging London boutique fashion
description: 1960s London boutique look: mini skirts and shift dresses, jumpsuits, hot pants, velvet and PVC, paisley and Liberty prints, collarless and kaftan jackets, bold colour.
notes: Includes pop-art strand (Mr Freedom: satin appliqué jackets, T-shirt dresses). Related: SC-mod (merge? no; adjacent).

name: Madchester (baggy)
description: Late-1980s Manchester baggy look: wide flared jeans, stonewash Wrangler flares and cords, oversized printed T-shirts, bomber jackets, bucket hats, football casual and outdoor jackets.
notes: Overlaps SC-rave and SC-casuals if present; V&A labels the look Ravers/Madchester UK 1987-8.

name: Latex and fetish fashion
description: Latex and rubber clothing from fetish scenes: catsuits, leotards, bodysuits, stockings, gloves, hoods, corsets, dresses, plus heavy leather wear and PVC.
notes: Murray and Vern: self-described London fetish-scene pioneers (own site, Wikipedia).

name: Club kids
description: 1990s New York nightlife costume dress: outrageous DIY outfits, wigs, clown makeup, gas masks, lunch boxes, sequins, glitter, fake blood, fluid gender expression.
notes: Page says homemade costume mattered more than designer labels; brand list thin.

name: Modern dandy (dandyism)
description: Refined tailored menswear with bold touches: slim suits, waistcoats, double-breasted jackets, high-waisted pleated trousers, silk scarves, pocket squares, cufflinks, pinstripes, emerald or burgundy accents.
notes: Brand-light genre; SC-sape and SC-peacock-revolution related. Historic Brummell dress: dark coat, pantaloons, cravat.

name: Bridalwear
description: Wedding gowns by silhouette and fabric: ball gown, mermaid, A-line, lace, mikado, tulle, chiffon, beading, trains, veils, capes and detachable sleeves.
notes: Occasion (not subculture), but pages say brides choose by brand/designer: 'all about the designer'.
